name: @jeremywalton/github-tui
description: A terminal UI for GitHub: your pull requests, repositories, and notifications inbox
author: Jeremy Walton

scripts.check-secrets: ! git grep --untracked -nIE 'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{22,}' || (echo 'Possible GitHub token found above. Remove it.' && false)
scripts.check: npm run check-secrets && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.prepack: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && npm run build
